maya: Heads up — scheduled cache-cluster migration Sun 2026-03-29 02:00–04:00 UTC. We're reshuffling edge-kv pools and updating shard mapping. Expect short p95 latency spikes and a small SLO burn during warmup. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/cache-migration (internal). Please ack if you own routes that need exclusion. :loud_sound:
angelo: Ack. Which routes are in the initial canary?
maya: Canary targets: internal-dev, beta, and ~10% of prod traffic in west-1. We'll monitor KV hit-rate and ramp after warmup. Snippet: ```yaml
canary_percent: 10
routes:
  - /v1/generate
  - /v1/chat
```
liz: Does this touch embeddings endpoints? Our partner tests run that window.
maya: Embeddings (embed-*) are on a separate pool and will be staggered. @liz I can remove embeddings from the canary — do you want that?
liz: Please exclude embeddings for partner-org. Thanks.
ops-eng: Noted, will update routing policy to exclude embed-* for partner-org. Any status page blurb?
sre_oncall: I'll add: "Intermittent increased latency for prediction endpoints during maintenance; no data loss expected."
deploy-bot: Scheduled job: cache-migrate-job-2026-03-29-02:00 UTC. CI checks green.
maya: Post-migration checks: KV hit-rate >= 90% within 10m, 5xx rate < 0.5% (10m window). Abort/rollback criteria: SLO burn > 2x or persistent >1% 5xx.
angelo: I'll be on-call for the window and watching canary dashboards. Ping me for rollback.
maya: Thanks — I'll post live status updates in this thread during the migration. :eyes:
ops-eng: Quick Q — do we need a quiet window for scheduled traffic?
maya: We'll enable quiet-window 01:45–04:15 UTC to reduce background jobs; noncritical batch jobs should be deferred.
sre_oncall: Acknowledged. Updating rota and escalation plan.
angelo: Got it. All prep steps done on my side.
maya: Great — final reminder Fri 10:00 PT. If anyone needs exclusion or extra monitoring, flag here before Fri EOD.
